name: STEVE Hypersurface Generation
definition: STEVE extracts a 3D hypersurface from 4D space-time data (toxels) by generating oriented tetrahedrons (3-simplices) that represent the iso-surface within 4D-cells.
summary: STEVE extracts rift-free, fully enclosing 4D iso-hypersurfaces directly in four dimensions, avoiding the extrusion to five dimensions used by other methods.
